name: Saffron Sweet Rice
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 large scoop (⅛ tsp) saffron (expensive but worth it!)
¼–½ cup slivered almonds, toasted if desired

steps: Wash rice and add enough water cover rice with water equal to the depth of the rice.
Cook over high heat until water disappears and steam is rising from holes in the surface of the rice.
Cover tightly and let stand for 20 minutes.
